videos.overview: The three finalists cook a meal in the studio and go to France to work in a kitchen. It's been on a gentle simmer for the past six weeks, now it reaches boiling point: 132 contestants have been reduced to three, each of whom hopes to win the title of MasterChef 2008. The shows have been as delicious as some of the dishes, although no-one will miss those dreadful shouted soundbites from John Torode and Gregg Wallace that are repeated ad nauseam in the intro. videos.overview: It’s the last quarter-final, and the best cooks from the week’s heats are back with one thing in their sights: a place in knockout week.

videos.title: Episode 16
videos.overview: Knockout week has arrived. Sixteen amateurs compete for the final ten places and the opportunity to tackle their first professional kitchen service.

videos.title: Episode 17
videos.overview: Knockout week continues as the second group of eight hopefuls return to take on the competition. Those who show they mean business will earn the right to work in their first professional kitchen.

videos.title: Episode 18
videos.overview: Knockout week comes to a head with just ten cooks remaining in the competition. Success could mean a place in the semi-finals, but it will take every ounce of effort to get there.

videos.title: Episode 19
videos.overview: It's semi-finals time, and the challenges include catering for members of the Jane Austen Society, not to mention a descendant of the famous author!

videos.title: Episode 20
videos.overview: The semi-finals continue, with the brief for the remaining six cooks set by none other than pioneer of molecular gastronomy Heston Blumenthal.

videos.title: Episode 21
videos.overview: It's the last step before finals week, and the challenge for the amateurs is to cook something amazing using an ingredient they detest.

videos.title: Episode 22
videos.overview: Finals week on MasterChef has arrived! Seven weeks of intense competition has seen some extraordinary competitors fall by the wayside, and now just four are left standing.

videos.title: Episode 23
videos.overview: Finals week continues, and the final four get the chance to take part in one of the most exciting Chef’s Tables in MasterChef history.

videos.title: Episode 24
videos.overview: This is the big one. The 21st MasterChef grand final. Weeks of hard graft have led to this moment when one of the three finalists will come out on top.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: It’s the first heat of this year’s competition, and six talented cooks are braced for culinary battle. Their first goal is to secure one of four gleaming MasterChef aprons.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: Six more amateurs work to secure a place in this week’s quarter-final as they are put through their paces by Grace and Anna in the second heat of the week.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: It's the first quarter-final, where this week’s six most talented amateurs gather to face off against each other for the first time.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: A new set of incredible amateur cooks take on the MasterChef heats hoping to secure a quarter-final place. Their first task is to serve up an impressive signature dish.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: A fresh set of hopeful home cooks serve up their signature dishes and precision cooking in a bid to impress the MasterChef judges and get through to the quarter-finals.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: The second quarter-final is here, and the six best cooks of the week return to prove they have more culinary skill in the tank, starting with an invention test.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: Heat three is upon us, which means one thing: six exciting new amateur cooks have left their home kitchens ready to compete for one of four coveted MasterChef aprons.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: It’s time for the second heat of the week, with six more home cooks putting themselves in the culinary spotlight, ready to show the judges that they have what it takes.

videos.title: Episode 9
videos.overview: The week closes with the third quarter-final as the six best cooks of the week return, taking on two more challenges to prove they have the nerve and skill to go even further.

videos.title: Episode 10
videos.overview: It’s the last round of heats. A new batch of amateur cooks enter the MasterChef kitchen ready to show off their culinary skills, hoping to get through to the next round.

videos.title: Episode 11
videos.overview: A brand new batch of amateur cooks enter the MasterChef kitchen, ready to compete in the first round and take their shot at culinary stardom.

videos.title: Episode 12
videos.overview: It’s time for the week’s six best cooks to dig deep and deliver in the last quarter-final of the competition.

videos.title: Episode 13
videos.overview: It’s knockout week, and there are just 14 amateur cooks left in the competition. The judges are increasing the pressure to see which contestants can hold their nerve.

videos.title: Episode 14
videos.overview: Knockout week continues, and the chefs must prove themselves enough to make it into their first professional kitchen.

videos.title: Episode 15
videos.overview: Knockout week is coming to an end, but not before a few more cooks have to say goodbye. Ten contestants remain, and there is only room in the semi-finals for eight.

videos.title: Episode 16
videos.overview: It’s semi-finals time, and the eight remaining cooks are ready to battle it out for a chance at victory. Anna and Grace ramp things up with their biggest challenges yet.

videos.title: Episode 17
videos.overview: The semi-finals continue, and just seven extraordinary home cooks remain in the competition. It’s time for them to dig even deeper into their culinary books of tricks.

videos.title: Episode 18
videos.overview: The semi-finals reach their end, and this is the most crucial stage of all. Which four of the five remaining cooks have what it takes to get that coveted place in Finals Week?

videos.title: Episode 19
videos.overview: Six weeks of fraught competition have produced four exceptional amateur cooks, who all stand a chance of being enlisted into the MasterChef hall of fame.

videos.title: Episode 20
videos.overview: The finals continue with the four finalists back in the UK, where they will be taking on their biggest task to date.

videos.title: The Final
videos.overview: MasterChef 2026 has seen seven weeks of competition, all leading to this one moment: it’s the final, and one of the three exceptional cooks remaining will be taking home the trophy.
